question: Does stock modlib_insert call an ELF entry point, or only .init_array/.fini_array?
prototype_hypothesis: modlib_insert() resolves relocations, then calls every .preinit_array/.init_array entry and retains .fini_array
callsite_evidence: modlib_getsymtab 0x0C1D906C reads globals 0x200EFDE8/0x200EFDEC (both zero, no writer found)
control_flow_evidence: rmmod -> modlib_remove 0x0C1D9418 invokes .fini_array before releasing module allocations
ownership_analysis: module allocations owned by modlib registry; released on remove
unsafe_assumptions: no modlib_setsymtab writer exists, so undefined-symbol imports cannot resolve
